data_policy: Only publish programme facts supported by the programme's own official website or an official government/European Union source. Unknown values remain null or unknown. Programme-cycle status is separate from admissions eligibility and funding.

programmes.title: European Master in Law, Data and Artificial Intelligence (EMILDAI)
programmes.duration: Not stated in the reviewed source
partner_institutions: Six partner universities; includes Erasmus University Rotterdam and Fundação Getulio Vargas from the 2026/2028 intake
programmes.application_notes: Round 1 opens 16 November 2026 and closes 17 January 2027; round 1 considers full and partial funding. A second round opens 21 March 2027 for self-funded applicants only.
programmes.funding_notes: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme. The programme page describes full and partial funding in round 1; individual award values and eligibility must be checked in the official admissions information.
programmes.notes: Interdisciplinary programme delivered by six partner universities. programmes.title: Master of Management in Analytics (MMA) – In-Person
programmes.application_notes: The official admissions page lists 15 January 2027 as the final deadline for international students for the Summer 2027 in-person intake. A separate March 15 deadline applies to Canadian citizens and permanent residents.
programmes.funding_notes: See the official tuition and financial aid page for the 2027 entering class. StudyBridge does not currently display a tuition figure in this record.
programmes.notes: In-person delivery in Montreal. McGill also offers an online version; this record represents only the in-person delivery.

programmes.title: Master of Information (MI)
programmes.application_notes: The Faculty of Information states that applications are open for September 2027 entry and that all supporting documents must be submitted by 31 January. Check the official admissions page for exact requirements and updates.
programmes.funding_notes: The faculty describes automatic consideration for entrance awards for applicants meeting the stated GPA and file-completion conditions; award details and eligibility must be checked directly with the faculty.
programmes.notes: The Master of Information offers eight concentrations. Admission requirements and academic equivalencies must be checked directly with the Faculty of Information.
